node_types.blurb: band-limited oscillator (sine/saw/square/tri/pulse); freq may be a node (pitch sweeps, FM); sync (hard sync from a master signal), unison + detune + spread (supersaw), pm (phase modulation)

freq.description: Hz; a node here sweeps or frequency-modulates.

phase.description:
Start phase, 0..1 (default 0). With `unison` > 1 only the first voice
starts here; the others start at seeded random phases.

amp.description:
Linear amplitude (default 1). Unison voices are summed, not averaged:
`unison` 7 is about sqrt(7) times louder than one voice.

sync.description:
Hard sync: a mono signal (the master); every rising zero crossing
resets this oscillator's phase, band-limited with polyBLEP at the
reset. The master crossing is placed to a fraction of a sample.

unison.description:
Voices stacked on `freq`, 1..16 (default 1). More than 1 makes the
node random (seeded start phases).

detune.description:
Unison detune, cents 0..1200 (default 0): the voices are spread evenly
from -detune to +detune around `freq`.

spread.description:
Stereo width of the unison voices, 0..1 (default 0 = mono). Above 0
the output is stereo: voices alternate left and right, the outermost
hard-panned at 1 (a balance law: a centred voice is unchanged in both
channels).

pm.description:
Phase modulation, in cycles (1 = a full turn), a signal: a node here
adds to the phase, so an `osc` into `pm` is FM.

seed.description:
Mixed with the document seed and the node name (default 0); picks the
unison start phases.

color.description:
white (default), pink (-3 dB/oct), brown (-6 dB/oct), blue (+3 dB/oct),
violet (+6 dB/oct), velvet (one random-sign impulse per cell: smooth,
cheap reverb-like texture), crackle (random-sign, random-height
impulses at random, irregular times).

density.description:
Velvet and crackle: impulses a second (default 2000 for velvet, 50 for
crackle); a number or a signal. Velvet above the sample rate is
capped at one a sample.

seed.description: Mixed with the document seed and the node name (default 0).

schema.title: Filter
schema.description: A state-variable filter (12 dB an octave; lp and hp can be steeper).

mode.description: lp (default), hp, bp, notch, peak, lowshelf, highshelf.

freq.description: Cutoff / centre, Hz (a node sweeps it).

gain_db.description: peak and shelves: boost (+) or cut (-), dB.

slope.description:
Steepness in dB an octave: 12 (default), 24 or 48. lp and hp only
(cascaded 12 dB sections with Butterworth Q spread, flat in the
passband); `q` scales the last section, so the default q is a pure
Butterworth. Not available inside a feedback loop.

An input: a number, a constant stereo pair `[l, r]`, or another node's

mode.description:
tanh (default: warm saturation), clip (hard), fold (wavefolder:
bright, metallic), bitcrush (quantize to `bits`), rectify (absolute
value: an octave up), asym (tanh of the signal plus `bias`, the
resting value taken off: even harmonics), diode (unity slope at 0,
the positive half saturates at +1 exponentially, the negative at
-0.5: even harmonics and a DC offset), tube (positive half
saturates at +1 with a sharp knee, negative at -0.7 with a soft
one: even harmonics at high drive), table (the curve in `points`).

drive.description: Gain before the shaper (default 1; may be a signal).

bias.description:
asym: where on the tanh curve the signal rests (default 0.5; 0 is
plain tanh; any finite value; the further from 0, the more even
harmonics and the more DC: follow with a high-pass).

points.description:
table: the curve as `[[x, y], ...]` (x increasing, at most 4096
points), linear between points and held at the ends. When no x is
negative the curve is odd-extended (y(-x) = -y(x)), and a point at
x = 0 must have y = 0.

oversample.description:
Times the shaper runs faster than the sample rate: 1 (default), 2, 4
or 8. More removes aliasing from the harmonics the curve makes and
costs that many times the work (the shaper's input is band-limited
to 0.45 of the sample rate on the way up). Not allowed inside a
feedback loop.

mix.description:
Wet / dry, 0..1 (default 1; may be a signal). 0 is the input,
before `drive`.

schema.title: Wander
schema.description:
Smooth random motion: random points `rate` times a second joined by
smooth (cubic Hermite) curves. Foley's `Wobble` low-passes white noise
instead; points give a bounded, rate-true wander that an agent can reason
about, so this differs on purpose.

min.description: With `max`: the same as `range: [min, max]` (not with `range`).

max.description: With `min`: the same as `range: [min, max]` (not with `range`).

seed.description: Mixed with the document seed and the node name (default 0).

op.description:
add, sub, mul, div (x / 0 = 0), min, max, pow (sign-preserving), abs
(of a), mix (a + (b - a) * t).

node_types.blurb: the sound: gain, loudness or peak target, edge fades and a ceiling limiter; exactly one

lufs.description:
Then normalize to this integrated loudness, LUFS (default: leave).
A very peaky or short sound cannot reach a high target under the
ceiling: use `peak_db` for it. Not together with `peak_db`.

peak_db.description:
Or normalize the pre-limiter sample peak to this, dBFS (clicks,
ticks, short hits; default: leave). Not together with `lufs`; not
above `ceiling_db`. `gain_db` is added on top, as it is for `lufs`.

fade_in.description:
Edge fades, seconds (defaults 0.002 in, 0.005 out; 0 for a loop).
A hit that starts inside the fade-in is cut by it: set `fade_in`
0.0005 (0.5 ms; zero at sample 0, so `silent_edges` passes). The
`lufs` / `peak_db` target is met after the fades. The fade-in
warning ("the 2 ms fade-in is cutting the first hit") is not given
for a `fade_in` of 1 ms or less, nor when a `lufs` / `peak_db` target
is set and met (the delivered level is right); with no target it
still fires when the fade cuts the first hit by 1 dB or more.

ceiling_db.description:
Lookahead limiter ceiling, dBFS (default -1). The limiter holds the
TRUE peak (4x oversampled, the estimator behind the `true_peak_db`
check) at the ceiling, not just the sample peak, so a delivered
sound measures at or under it (within 0.01 dB) in `true_peak_db`. A
sound whose true peak is already under the ceiling passes through
bit-identical; one whose samples are under the ceiling but whose
inter-sample peak is over it is now turned down (before, it was not).

node_types.blurb: a struck object: excite audio rings modes computed from material, size, shape (plate bar tube membrane string shell) and strike position (bigger = lower); thickness (m) overrides the material's; f0 (Hz) sets size from the lowest mode; f_min / f_max keep only modes in a band; loss scales the ring time, tilt (dB/oct) the mode balance; a unit impulse peaks near 0 dBFS

schema.title: Modal
schema.description:
A struck object: the `excite` audio rings a bank of modes computed from a
material, a size and a shape. A unit impulse (or a `contact` of area 1)
peaks at 0 dBFS, whatever the shape, size and material.

excite.description:
The strike: a `contact` pulse, an impulse, a noise burst, a `friction`
stream.

material.description:
stone wood metal glass ice earth granular plant soft snow, or
{young, density, poisson, loss, thickness}.

size.description:
Side of the plate, length of the bar or string, diameter of the tube
or membrane, metres; the bell's size. Bigger rings lower (pitch goes
as 1 / size^2; for membrane and string as 1 / size). Read once, at the
start (a `$param` or `=expr` works). The usable range is where the
lowest mode falls between 24 Hz and 90 % of the top of the band
(18 kHz at 48 kHz): a size outside it is an error that names the range
for the material and shape, and the thickness that would fix it.
Modes above the top of the band are dropped, never folded back.
Leave it out when `f0` is given.

f0.description:
Frequency of the lowest mode of the shape, Hz (20..18000, a number,
`$param` or `=expr`, read once): sets `size` so that the table's lowest
mode sits here, from the shape's own table and the effective material
and `thickness` (the seeded mistuning moves it by up to 1.5 % for a
plate, 0.3 % for the others). Giving both `f0` and `size` is an error.
`f_min` does not move it: it drops modes, not the size.

f_min.description:
Keep only modes at or above this frequency, Hz (default none). Applied
after the mode table and before the `modes` cap, so `modes` counts kept
modes. A band with no mode in it is an error that gives the table's range.

f_max.description: Keep only modes at or below this frequency, Hz (default none); see `f_min`.

shape.description: What is struck: plate (default) bar tube membrane string shell.

strike_position.description:
Where it is struck, 0..1 (default 0.3). Plate: 0.5 is the centre,
which silences every mode with a node there. Bar, string: along the
length. Membrane: radius, 0 the centre. Tube: around the wall. Shell:
ignored (a bell is struck on the lip).

modes.description:
Most modes kept (default 48, 1..256). The lowest half of them are
always the lowest modes of the object, the rest the strongest.

stiffness.description:
String only: the inharmonicity B in f_n = n f_1 sqrt(1 + B n^2),
0..1 (default 0: exactly harmonic; a piano string is about 0.0004).

loss.description:
Multiplier on the material's loss (default 1, range 0.01..100):
0.5 rings twice as long, 2 half as long. T60 is still capped at 20 s
per mode.

thickness.description:
Thickness of the plate, bar wall, tube wall, membrane or string
stand-in, metres (default: the material's; range 0.0001..0.5). Every
mode frequency goes as the thickness, so 0.0015 gives a coin, 0.003 a
shard, 0.004 a key without a custom material. A number, `$param` or
`=expr`, read once. The size range in the error and the hint use this
thickness.

tilt.description:
dB per octave on the mode gains about the lowest mode (default 0,
-12..12): positive lifts the upper modes (flattens a table that is
all in its first mode), negative darkens. The output is normalized
after, so only the balance moves.

gain_db.description:
Level of the output in dB after the normalization (default 0, -60..60):
balances a body against a click without a `gain` node, and a macro can
map it. Absent or 0 leaves the samples unchanged.

strike_glide.description:
Pitch glide of a hard strike, cents (default none, 0..1200): every
mode starts this far sharp at the ring's loudest and settles as it
decays (the pitch follows the level, as a struck plate's tension
does). Left out or 0, the samples are unchanged.

rattle.description:
A loose part buzzing while the ring is loud, 0..1 (default none): the
part of the ring above a gap (the ring's level, its loudest 5 ms as a
sine peak, at 0; 30 dB under it at 1) is
added back high-passed above 1.5 kHz, so the buzz lasts longer as
`rattle` rises and stops when the ring falls under the gap. Left out
or 0, the samples are unchanged.

noise.description:
How noisy each mode rings, 0..1 (default none): each mode's clean
ring is mixed (1 - noise : noise) with a band of white noise at the
mode's frequency, `noise_width` wide, that follows the ring's own
envelope and decay. At 1 no line is left, only noise bands placed and
decaying like the modes: wood and stone knock, metal washes, nothing
chimes. Left out or 0, the samples are unchanged.

noise_width.description:
How wide each mode's noise band is, as a fraction of its frequency
(default 0.25, 0.05..2; only with `noise`). Wider than the gaps
between partials, the bands merge into a wash.

seed.description:
Mixed with the document seed and the node name (default 0): the
mistuning.

node_types.blurb: a strike or drop solved as one system: a striker (or the floor, when the object is dropped) and modal's modes coupled by a Hunt-Crossley contact per sample; bounces under gravity, chatter and buzz come from the physics; peaks at -6 dBFS; port `force` is the contact force above the resting load (1 at its peak, 0 off contact and at rest): a trigger for crack layers

schema.title: Impact
schema.description:
A strike solved as one system: a point mass (the striker, or a rigid
floor when the object itself is dropped) and the object's modes, coupled
through a Hunt-Crossley contact and stepped together per sample. The
contact feels the surface move under it, so chatter, rebounds, a bounce
train under gravity and a ringing object buzzing on the floor come out of
the physics. The mode table is `modal`'s.

material.description: The object: as `modal` (a name or constants).

shape.description: plate (default) bar tube membrane string shell, as `modal`.

size.description: Size of the object, metres, as `modal` (or `f0`).

loss.description: As `modal`: multiplier on the material's loss (default 1).

tilt.description: As `modal`: dB per octave on the radiated mode levels (default 0).

noise.description: As `modal`: noise bands instead of clean lines, 0..1.

strike_position.description: Where the object is hit, 0..1 (default 0.3), as `modal`.

modes.description: Most modes (default 32, 1..96: each is stepped per substep).

object_mass.description:
Mass of the object, kg (default 0.5). Each mode's modal mass is a
quarter of it; in a drop it is also the falling mass.

striker_mass.description:
Mass of a striker, kg (0.001..100). Given: a striker falls or flies
onto the held object. Left out: the object itself is dropped onto a
rigid `floor`.

hardness.description: Striker hardness 0..1 (default 0.7; rubber to steel), as `contact`.

floor.description: What a dropped object lands on (default "stone"), as `material`.

height.description:
Drop height, metres (0.001..20). Turns gravity on: things fall back
and bounce. A drop defaults to 0.3.

speed.description:
Impact speed, m/s (0.01..50), instead of `height` (no gravity for a
striker; a drop keeps gravity and starts at this speed).

radius.description:
Radius of curvature at the contact, metres (default 0.01; a striker's
is its own ball radius when left out). Smaller = sharper, brighter.

bounce.description:
Coefficient of restitution of each contact, 0..0.98 (default 0.5):
how much speed a bounce keeps (the modes take some more).

scatter.description:
0..1 (default 0.3): seeded scatter per contact of the restitution and
of each mode's coupling (a tumbling object lands on another point).

max_bounces.description:
Contacts before it settles (default 40, 1..400): after these it stays
in contact (restitution 0).

oversample.description:
Substeps per sample at least (default 4, 1..64; raised by itself so the
shortest contact spans 20 substeps).

at.description: When it starts, seconds (default 0); the first contact follows at once.

gain_db.description:
Output level, dB (default 0, -60..60). The output peaks at -6 dBFS
before it.

drive.description:
A force on the moving body, newtons (a signal, default none; positive
pushes it down onto the object or the floor). Shaking (an `lfo`) is a
rattle, a slow `ramp` a press, a pulsed `wander` an uneven roll. With
it a striker needs no `height` or `speed`: it starts at rest, touching.

excite.description:
Audio pushing the modes at the contact point (default none), as
`modal`'s `excite`, while the contact runs: wind on a sign that is
also hit. A sample of 1 kicks the contact point at 1 m/s, so a unit
impulse is about as loud as a 1 m/s strike.

pitch.description:
Ratio on every mode frequency (a signal, default 1, held in
0.25..4). Not physical: a bend while it rings.

damping.description:
Multiplier on every mode's decay rate (a signal, default 1, held in
0.05..20): 2 dies twice as fast; a hand closing on the object.

stiffness.description:
Multiplier on the contact stiffness (a signal, default 1, held in
0.01..100): lower is a softer, duller touch.

slide.description:
Speed along the surface while in contact, m/s (a signal, default 0):
a ball rolling, a block or a bow sliding. Keep it pressed with
gravity (`height`) or a `drive`.

roughness.description:
RMS height of the surface's bumps under the contact, metres (default
0; 1e-6 a polished floor, 3e-5 a rough board, 2e-4 gravel). With
`slide`, the contact rides the profile: a roll.

grain.description:
Distance between the surface's bumps, metres (default 0.002,
0.0001..0.1). Keep it at least the contact `radius`: a ball cannot
fall into a narrower dip.

octaves.description:
Scales in the surface profile (default 6, 1..8): `grain` and finer
octaves, each half the spacing and 0.2 the height. 1 is one scale of
bumps, heard as a crackle in a roll (the batch 24 scrape was picked
with it).

wobble.description:
Out-of-roundness of a rolling ball, metres (default 0; 1e-6 a good
marble, 2e-5 a dented one): its centre rises and falls once a turn
(every 2 pi `radius` of `slide`), the periodic pulse that tells a roll
from a scrape.

rebound.description:
How a landing rebounds (default "exact"): "exact" leaves at
`bounce` x the landing speed (the modes no longer swallow a light
striker's bounce); "cap" only limits it to that, so the modes can take
more (how batches 22-24 were heard; their parts use it).

friction.description:
`[static, dynamic]` friction coefficients (default none: no friction,
a pure roll). With `slide`, a stick-slip force drags the surface
along: a scrape, a creak, a bowed squeal that locks to a mode.

stribeck.description:
Speed where friction falls from static to dynamic, m/s (default 0.1,
0.001..10): lower locks harder to a mode.

seed.description: Mixed with the document seed and the node name (default 0).

gravity.description: Gravity, m/s^2 (default 9.81; 0 for a hit in free space).

oversample.description:
Substeps per sample at least (default 4, 1..64; raised so the
shortest contact spans 20 substeps).

gain_db.description: Output level, dB (default 0). The output peaks at -6 dBFS before it.

seed.description: Mixed with the document seed and the node name (default 0).

fixed.description:
Held in place (default false): a fixed body does not translate (a
clamped plate, a bell on its stand); its modes still ring.

velocity.description:
Starting speed, m/s (default 0; positive is up, so a thrown hammer
coming down is negative).

drive.description: A force on the body, newtons (a signal; positive is up).

material.description: A modal object (default none: a point mass): `modal`'s material.

shape.description: plate (default) bar tube membrane string shell.

level_db.description:
Level of this body in the output, dB (default 0): a modal body
radiates; a point mass is silent.

waveguide.description:
A waveguide body (default none): a string or a tube; see
`docs/nodes/rig.md`. Not with `material`.

A rig body that is a waveguide (`waveguide` on a body; the body's `mass`
is the string's mass, and a tube ignores it). It does not translate.

f0.description: Lowest frequency, Hz (a string: or `length` with `tension`).

length.description: Length, metres (a tube: tunes it; a string: with `tension`).

ends.description: A tube's ends: open (default), closed, stopped.

decay.description:
Seconds for the lowest frequency to fall 60 dB (default: string 3,
tube 0.8).

damping.description:
Loss of the highs at each round trip, 0..1 (default 0.3): 0 bright,
1 dull.

oneOf.description: A string fixed at both ends.
An air column.

TubeEnds.description:
The ends of a tube: `open` (both open, c / 2L), `closed` (closed at 0,
open at 1: c / 4L), `stopped` (both closed, c / 2L).

RigJoint.description:
One joint of a rig, between body `a` (above) and body `b` (below; or
"ground", rigid and fixed).

at_a.description:
Where on `a` it attaches, 0..1, as `modal`'s `strike_position`
(default 0.3; a point mass ignores it).

gap.description:
Contact: the starting distance between them, metres (default 0,
touching); a body dropped from 0.3 m onto another is `gap` 0.3.
Spring: the free play either side of its rest length (default 0).

hardness.description:
Contact: hardness of the pair 0..1 (default 0.7, rubber to steel),
as `contact`'s, when neither side has a material.

radius.description: Contact: radius of curvature at the touch, metres (default 0.01).

damp.description:
Contact: what its damping acts on (default "body"): "body" damps the
bodies' own motion, so a bounce keeps `bounce` while the modes ring
on (and the rebound off a held body is held to `bounce`); "point"
damps the full speed at the touch, vibration included, with no
rebound cap (how the batch 27 / 28 rigs were heard).

rebound.description:
Contact with `damp` "body": how a real rebound leaves (default
"exact": at `bounce` x the landing speed; "cap": only limited to it,
as the batch 30 wind chime was heard).

slide.description:
Contact: speed of `a` along `b`'s surface, m/s (a signal, default 0):
a bow drawn, a box dragged, a stick scraped.

friction.description:
Contact: `[static, dynamic]` friction coefficients (default none: no
drag). With `slide`, a Stribeck stick-slip drag drives a sliding copy
of both sides' modes (as `impact`'s `friction`): a bow sings near the
`stribeck` speed, a faster slide scrapes.

stribeck.description:
Contact: the speed where friction falls from static to dynamic, m/s
(default 0.1, 0.001..10).

oneOf.description: Hunt-Crossley: pushes `a` up off `b` only while they overlap.

A spring and damper; with a `gap` it only pulls past the gap (a loose
part rattling on its fixing).

`a`'s velocity at `at_a` drives end 0 of the tube `b`, and the air
pushes back on `a` (`strength`).
